step_2_verify_the_shared_operative_claim.reasoning: The cached corpus uses exactly this convention for defensive mechanics. data/champion-audit/batch-6.json records for Vi: 'P Blast Shield is explicitly documented as defensive-only (\'does not change outgoing TDD\')', and the same file lists the non-damaging entry 'P (Blast Shield - defensive shield, does not change outgoing TDD)'. Likewise data/champion-audit/batch-1.json (Ekko): R heal and W shield are 'both sustain/defense, outside TDD'. A defence/durability mechanic changing incoming-damage survivability and not the outgoing-damage functional is the corpus's own audited semantics.
step_2_verify_the_shared_operative_claim.math_doc_cross_check: docs/math-foundations.md defines the scored number as T = E[ D | model, config ] (Section 0), an outgoing-damage functional; shield/heal/durability terms appear only in the survival walk (Sec. 5 table rows 'Shield absorption', 'Grey health', 'Revive') and in the EHP identity 'A target with H0 health and resistance R survives exactly H0*(1+R/100)' (Sec. 2.2). Durability terms therefore enter effective health, never T. Both strings' operative clause is consistent with this.

step_3_verify_the_NEW_string_s_added_uni.result: UNSUPPORTED, and FALSE under the only family taxonomy that exists in the cached data

taxonomy_census.note: Neither vocabulary contains a family named 'defence', 'defense', or 'durability'. The strings 'defence' and 'durability' do not occur anywhere under data/ (grep -rn over the whole export: 0 hits each).

quantifier_census_over_all_324_items.conclusion: No item in the cached corpus has an all-defensive declared family set. Every item declares 'economy' (shop-price atoms), which is not a defence; 276/324 also declare 'stat'. The universal claim is therefore false for every possible referent item, whatever the Syndra build at breakdown[0] happens to be.

worked_counterexample_for_the_likeliest_.item: Zhonya's Hourglass (id 3157) — the canonical purely-defensive active on an AP mage build such as Syndra's
Time Stop: 'Put yourself in {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, rendering you {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|invulnerable}} for the duration but also unable to move, declare [[basic attack]]s, cast [[champion ability|abilities]], use [[summoner spell]]s, or [[active ability items|activate items]].'
worked_counterexample_for_the_likeliest_.why_the_operative_clause_holds: Time Stop grants invulnerability/untargetability and explicitly forbids attacking and casting for its duration; it adds zero damage terms, so it cannot raise outgoing TDD. The old string's operative claim is exactly right for it.
worked_counterexample_for_the_likeliest_.why_the_added_universal_claim_fails: Zhonya's declared families are ['control','damage','economy','stat'] (computed from data/atoms/items.json .objects['3157']). The legacy per-item decomposition data/item-atoms/3157.json makes the 'damage' member explicit: {'atom_id': 'damage.resistance-mitigation', 'family': 'damage', 'behavior': 'Time Stop', 'provenance': {'evidence': 'active:Time Stop'}}. A declared 'damage' family (plus 'economy' and 'stat') directly contradicts 'Every declared family on this item is a defence.'

other_defensive_candidates_checked.note: Every one of them declares at least one non-defence family.

step_4_verify_delta_B (defense -> durabi.result: NEUTRAL — both wordings denote the same quantity (resistance to incoming damage) and both are consistent with docs/math-foundations.md Sec. 2.2's effective-health treatment. This wording change alone would not decide the verdict; it is the added universal quantifier that does.

independent_computation.step_5_adjudication: The two strings agree on the only claim the cached sources support, and the new string additionally asserts a universal proposition over 'declared families' that (a) is not expressible in any family taxonomy present in data/ — no 'defence'/'durability' family exists in either the champion-atom or item-atom vocabulary — and (b) is false for all 324 corpus items under the item-atom taxonomy, with Zhonya's Hourglass (the most likely referent for a Syndra build's first utility-only item) a direct counterexample because its Time Stop active decomposes to a 'damage'-family atom on top of the unavoidable 'economy' and 'stat' families. A reason string that is strictly a superset of a correct claim, where the added part is contradicted by the cached data, is less correct than the original. Verdict: old_value_correct.

limitations: The scenario id 'syndra_derived_order_39' does not appear anywhere in the permitted export (grep over data/ and docs/math-foundations.md: 0 hits; data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json holds 22 scenarios, none Syndra). The specific item at breakdown[0]/utility_outcomes/item_coverage[0] therefore could not be identified from the permitted sources, so the counterexample is argued two ways: (i) the universal claim fails for ALL 324 corpus items regardless of which one is the referent, and (ii) it fails concretely for Zhonya's Hourglass, the likeliest referent.

'Declared family' was interpreted against the only family taxonomies that exist in the cached data (data/atoms/items.json item-atom families; data/atoms/classification-report.json champion-atom families). If the engine maintains a separate, code-level family vocabulary in src/ containing a 'defence' family, that vocabulary is out of bounds for this runbook and was not consulted; under every taxonomy that is in the cached data, the new string's first clause is false.

Neither the operative clause's truth (which both strings share) nor the 'defense' -> 'durability' rewording is in dispute; the verdict turns solely on the unsupported universal quantifier the new value adds.
verdict_rationale: Both strings carry the same correct operative claim; the new string adds 'Every declared family on this item is a defence', which is contradicted by the cached item-atom data for all 324 items (all declare the non-defence 'economy' family, and the leading defensive candidate Zhonya's Hourglass additionally declares a 'damage'-family atom from its Time Stop active). The old value states only what the sources support.
